THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
None appear in this matter either physically or through video conference.
2. On 13.03.2023 this Court had made the following observation.
"Learned counsel for the appellant prays for one more short accommodation to comply with the office objections.
However, a perusal of the office objections, which are yet to be complied with, go to show that there are few trivial objections which would take hardly couple of minutes to comply with.

Hence, though the appeal could have been dismissed for non- compliance of office objections, since more than three years time has been given to the appellant, however, in the interest of justice imposing a cost of Rs.5,00/- payable by the appellant to the High Court Legal Services Committee of this Court and filing a compliance memo with receipt to that effect within the said time in the registry, as a final last opportunity, appellant is permitted to comply with the office objections in to-to during the course of the day, however, after paying the cost.
In case, office objections are not complied with list the matter on 15.03.2023."

3. Further on 15.03.2023 this Court has made the following observation:
"None appear in this matter.

2
Endorsement made by the registry is not clear.
At one place it says that office objections are not complied.
At the end of its submission it says that non compliance of office objections only with respect to non filing of compliance memo.
Registry to ascertain the same.
If all the four office objections, which have been raised originally are not complied with by the appellant, registry to list the matter on 20.03.2023."
Inspite of the above, the appellant has not complied with office objections for successful 8th time.
4. Appeal is of the year 2020 and no reason is forthcoming for nonappearance of the appellant and noncompliance of office objections.
Hence, appeal stands dismissed for noncompliance of office objections and for non-prosecution.
